Clamp to the end of the day instead.\n  if (endMinutes >= 24 * 60) {\n    return { start, end: { hour: 23, minute: 59, second: 59 } };\n  }\n  return {\n    start,\n    end: { hour: Math.floor(endMinutes / 60), minute: endMinutes % 60, second: 0 },\n  };\n}\n\n/** Minutes the given zone is offset from UTC at a particular instant (negative west of UTC). */\nfunction zoneOffsetMinutes(instant: Date, timeZone: string): number {\n  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(\"en-US\", {\n    timeZone,\n    hour12: false,\n    year: \"numeric\",\n    month: \"2-digit\",\n    day: \"2-digit\",\n    hour: \"2-digit\",\n    minute: \"2-digit\",\n    second: \"2-digit\",\n  }).formatToParts(instant);\n\n  const field = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value ?? \"0\");\n  // Intl renders midnight as hour 24 in some runtimes; normalise it.\n  const hour = field(\"hour\") % 24;\n\n  const asIfUtc = Date.UTC(\n    field(\"year\"),\n    field(\"month\") - 1,\n    field(\"day\"),\n    hour,\n    field(\"minute\"),\n    field(\"second\"),\n  );\n  return (asIfUtc - instant.getTime()) / 60000;\n}\n\n/**\n * Converts a wall-clock date and time in the business timezone into a real UTC instant.\n *\n * The offset depends on the instant we are trying to find, so this resolves it in two passes:\n * guess using the offset at the naive instant, then re-check the offset at that result. const naive = Date.UTC(\n    Number(dateMatch[1]),\n    Number(dateMatch[2]) - 1,\n    Number(dateMatch[3]),\n    time.hour,\n    time.minute,\n    time.second,\n  );\n\n  const firstOffset = \"application/x-www-form-urlencoded\",\n      },\n      body,\n    },\n  );\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    return { success: false, provider: \"twilio\", error: await res.text() };\n  }\n  return { success: true, provider: \"twilio\", result: await res.json() };\n}\n\n/**\n * Send an SMS. Skips when phone is missing or customer has opted out.\n * @param smsOptIn - when false, skip; when undefined/true, send\n */\nexport async function sendSms(\n  phone: string | null | undefined,\n  content: string,\n  options: { smsOptIn?: boolean | null } = {},\n): Promise<SendSmsResult> {\n  if (options.smsOptIn === false) {\n    return { success: true, skipped: true, reason: \"sms_opt_out\" };\n  }\n  const toE164 = normalizePhoneE164(phone);\n  if (!toE164) {\n    return { success: true, skipped: true, reason: \"invalid_phone\" };\n  }\n\n  try {\n    if (SMS_PROVIDER === \"twilio\") {\n      return await sendSmsTwilio(toE164, content);\n    }\n    return await sendSmsBrevo(toE164, content);\n  } catch (err) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n    };\n  }\n}\n"},{"name":"functions/_shared/displayPlanName.ts","content":"/** Customer-facing plan name. Remaps stored Dump Loader / 16 Yard Dumpster / DIY Heavy Equipment labels. */\nexport function formatCustomerFacingPlanName(name: unknown): string {\n  if (name == null || name === \"\") return name == null ? \"\" : String(name);\n  return String(name)\n    .replace(/Dump Loader Trailers/g, \"Dump Trailers\")\n    .replace(/dump loader trailers/g, \"dump trailers\")\n    .replace(/Dump Loader Trailer/g, \"Dump Trailer\")\n    .replace(/dump loader trailer/g, \"dump trailer\")\n    .replace(/Dump Loader/g, \"Dump Trailer\")\n    .replace(/dump loader/g, \"dump trailer\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]Yard Dumpster Rentals/g, \"Dumpster Rentals\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]yard dumpster rentals/g, \"dumpster rentals\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]Yard Dumpster Rental/g, \"Dumpster Rental\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]yard dumpster rental/g, \"dumpster rental\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]Yard Dumpster/g, \"Dumpster Rental\")\n    .replace(/16[- ]yard dumpster/g, \"dumpster rental\")\n    .replace(/Do-It-Yourself \\(DIY\\) Heavy Equipment/g, \"Compact Equipment Rental\")\n    .replace(/do-it-yourself \\(diy\\) heavy equipment/g, \"compact equipment rental\")\n    .replace(/DIY Heavy Equipment/g, \"Compact Equipment Rental\")\n    .replace(/diy heavy equipment/g, \"compact equipment rental\")\n    .replace(/Compact Equipment(?! Rental)/g, \"Compact Equipment Rental\")\n    .replace(/compact equipment(?! rental)/g, \"compact equipment rental\");\n}\n"},{"name":"functions/_shared/deliveryBooking.ts","content":"/**\n * Delivery vs yard self-pickup. PIN create / PIN email / lock confirm must skip delivery.\n *\n * Primary flag: addons.isDelivery (and deliveryService). Also honor delivery_type and\n * always-delivered catalog services (dumpster #1, dump trailer with delivery #4) when\n * the JSON flag is missing.\n */\n\nfunction asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {\n  if (value && typeof value === \"object\" && !Array.isArray(value)) {\n    return value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"string\") {\n    try {\n      const parsed = JSON.parse(value);\n      if (parsed && typeof parsed === \"object\" && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n        return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // ignore\n    }\n  }\n  return {};\n}\n\n/** Catalog services that are always company delivery (not a yard padlock pickup). */\nexport const ALWAYS_DELIVERY_PLAN_IDS = [1, 4];\n\nexport function isDeliveryBooking(\n  booking: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,\n): boolean {\n  if (!booking) return false;\n  const addons = asRecord(booking.addons);\n  const plan = asRecord(booking.plan);\n  if (addons.isDelivery === true || addons.deliveryService === true) return true;\n  if (booking.delivery_service === true) return true;\n  if (String(booking.delivery_type || \"\").toLowerCase() === \"delivery\") return true;\n  const planId = Number(plan.id);\n  return ALWAYS_DELIVERY_PLAN_IDS.includes(planId);\n}\n\n/**\n * True when this booking should get a yard padlock PIN (create, confirm, email/SMS).\n * Delivery is always excluded, even if the plan name contains \"trailer\".\n */\nexport function bookingNeedsYardLockPin(\n  booking: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,\n): boolean {\n  if (!booking || isDeliveryBooking(booking)) return false;\n  const plan = asRecord(booking.plan);\n  const name = String(plan.name ?? booking.service_name ?? \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const serviceType = String(plan.service_type ?? booking.service_type ?? \"\");\n  return (\n    serviceType === \"trailer_rental\" ||\n    Number(plan.id) === 2 ||\n    Number(plan.id) === 5 ||\n    name.includes(\"dump loader\") ||\n    name.includes(\"dump trailer\") ||\n    name.includes(\"trailer\") ||\n    plan.customer_pickup === true\n  );\n}\n"}]}
